en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval fortified riverside town. Dominating the left side is a massive round stone tower with machicolations and a battlemented crown, attached to a fortification on a rocky slope above a river and weir. Behind and to the right rise additional towers, steep‑roofed townhouses, and church spires typical of Central European architecture. In the lower right corner are riverside houses with tiled roofs and a small industrial or commercial building; faint signage is visible on one façade.
